# Growing Guns mod API

Every `*.luau` file under `mods/` is a module. It hot-reloads when saved: a load error keeps the previous version, a runtime error turns that module's hooks off until the file changes. Modules run on the host inside the 60 Hz sim tick, in path order; the same mods and seed replay exactly.

Sandbox: no `os`, `io`, `require`, `loadstring` or `math.random` (use `g:random()`). Each call gets a step budget (calls and loop iterations), the VM 64 MB. `state` is a per-module table that survives reloads. `print` goes to the game log. Do not depend on `pairs` order over tables keyed by tables or functions.

## Module exports

A module returns a table of this type (every key optional):

```luau
type Exports = {
	cards: { Card }?,
	hit: ((g: Game, e: Hit) -> number?)?,
	kill: ((g: Game, e: Kill) -> ())?,
	tick: ((g: Game) -> ())?,
	round_start: ((g: Game) -> ())?,
}
```

- `hit`: Before damage lands. Return the damage to deal (nil keeps it). Modules chain.
- `kill`: A player died.
- `tick`: End of every sim tick (60 per second). Keep it cheap.
- `round_start`: A new round's arena and spawns are ready.

```luau
type Hit = { victim: number, attacker: number, damage: number, head: boolean, explosion: boolean }
type Kill = { victim: number, attacker: number? }  -- attacker nil: lava
```

Dash is retired. The `dash_iframes`, `dash_end_melee` and `dash_spawn_bomb` weapon fields remain readable for old replay compatibility but have no gameplay effect. `dmg_up`, `big_mag` and `rapid_fire` have three times the ordinary draw weight.

## Cards

The pool is `mods/base/cards.luau`, a port of Godot's `card_library.gd`. A card's `apply(w)` mutates the player's `Weapon` exactly like the GDScript card does; the Godot helpers exist under the same names: `Color(r, g, b)`, `Vector3(x, y, z)`, `deg_to_rad`, `max`, `min`, `maxf`, `minf`, `clampf`, `lerp(a, b, t)` (numbers or vectors) and `warp(w, bone, scale)` for cosmetic bone scales. Weapons are rebuilt from the cards every round, so `apply` must only depend on `w`.

```luau
type Card = {
  id: string,             -- stable; what `give P ID` uses
  name: string?, desc: string?,
  color: vector?,         -- Color(r, g, b), sRGB 0..1
  tags: { string }?,      -- "firepower": improves the gun (every offer has one)
  rarity: string?,        -- "common" (weight 1) or "rare" (0.15, more for trailing players)
  apply: ((w: Weapon) -> ())?,  -- the card's effect
  mul: { [string]: number }?,  -- or as data: field multipliers, then
  add: { [string]: number }?,  -- field additions
  pick: ((g: Game, p: number) -> ())?,  -- runs once when taken (match effects)
}
```

## `Weapon` fields

Names match Godot's `weapon.gd`; read and write them as `w.field` in `apply`, or with `g:stat` / `g:set_stat`. Numbers unless noted.

- `damage_mult` (number)
- `fire_rate_mult` (number)
- `reload_mult` (number)
- `headshot_mult` (number)
- `mag_size_bonus` (whole number)
- `extra_projectiles` (whole number)
- `ricochet_count` (whole number)
- `body_ricochet_count` (whole number)
- `last_shot_damage_mult` (number)
- `silencer_stacks` (whole number)
- `spread` (number)
- `recoil_per_shot` (number)
- `lifesteal` (number)
- `explosive_radius` (number)
- `explosive_damage` (number)
- `move_speed_mult` (number)
- `knockback_mult` (number)
- `special_cooldown_mult` (number)
- `melee_damage_mult` (number)
- `melee_scale` (number)
- `homing` (number)
- `damage_over_time` (number)
- `dot_duration` (number)
- `slow_on_hit` (number)
- `slow_duration` (number)
- `grow_damage_per_meter` (number)
- `ricochet_damage_mult` (number)
- `reload_on_hit` (whole number)
- `phoenix_revives` (whole number)
- `world_pierce_count` (whole number)
- `impact_mines` (whole number)
- `bullet_color` (colour (vector))
- `bullet_speed_mult` (number)
- `bullet_scale` (number)
- `bullet_drop` (number)
- `head_scale` (number)
- `body_scale` (number)
- `body_scale_axes` (vector)
- `max_hp_bonus` (whole number)
- `extra_jumps` (whole number)
- `special_echo_count` (whole number)
- `special_reload_amount` (whole number)
- `special_cooldown_refund_on_hit` (number)
- `teleport_blast_radius` (number)
- `dash_iframes` (boolean)
- `dash_end_melee` (boolean)
- `dash_spawn_bomb` (boolean)
- `special` (string): one of grenade, teleport, zoom, sword, air_strike, ion_cannon, cluster_grenade

## `g`: the match

Players are numbers 1..`g:players()`. `g` is only valid during the call that received it.

- `g:players(): number`: Number of players.
- `g:alive(p: number): boolean`: Player p is alive.
- `g:bot(p: number): boolean`: Player p is a bot.
- `g:pos(p: number): vector`: Position (capsule centre), metres.
- `g:set_pos(p: number, v: vector)`: Teleport.
- `g:vel(p: number): vector`: Velocity, m/s.
- `g:set_vel(p: number, v: vector)`: Set velocity (knockback, launch pads).
- `g:aim(p: number): vector`: Unit vector the player looks along.
- `g:health(p: number): number`: Health (0 when dead).
- `g:set_health(p: number, hp: number)`: Set health, capped at max health. Does not kill: use damage.
- `g:max_health(p: number): number`: 100 plus the hp_bonus stat.
- `g:damage(p: number, amount: number, by: number?): boolean`: Damage at the start of the next tick, credited to player `by`; can kill, skips the hit hooks. False over quota.
- `g:ammo(p: number): number`: Rounds in the magazine.
- `g:set_ammo(p: number, n: number)`: Set rounds in the magazine.
- `g:score(p: number): number`: Rounds won.
- `g:stat(p: number, name: string): any`: A field of player p's Weapon (see stats()): number, boolean, vector or the special's name.
- `g:set_stat(p: number, name: string, value: any)`: Change a Weapon field for this round (cards are re-applied each round).
- `g:stats(): {string}`: Names of the Weapon fields.
- `g:special_cooldown(p: number): number`: Seconds until player p's RMB special is ready.
- `g:modifier(): string?`: This round's modifier id, or nil.
- `g:cards(p: number): {string}`: Ids of the cards player p holds, in pick order.
- `g:card_ids(): {string}`: Ids of every card on offer this match.
- `g:give(p: number, id: string): boolean`: Give a card at the start of the next tick (stats and pick hook). False over quota.
- `g:explode(at: vector, radius: number, damage: number, by: number?): boolean`: Explosion at the start of the next tick. False over quota (32 per tick).
- `g:tick(): number`: Sim ticks since the match started (60 per second).
- `g:time(): number`: Match time in seconds.
- `g:round(): number`: Round number, from 1.
- `g:between_rounds(): boolean`: The round is over (intermission and card picks).
- `g:random(): number`: Uniform in [0, 1), from the match seed: the same every replay.
